description: This file is a Java source file containing unit tests for the HibernateOrderDAO class in the OpenMRS project. It tests various database operations related to OrderGroup, OrderAttributeType, and OrderGroupAttributeType, including saving, retrieving, and deleting entities, and checks for expected exceptions.

classes.name: HibernateOrderDAOTest
classes.description: Unit test class for HibernateOrderDAO, testing CRUD operations and retrieval methods for OrderGroup and related entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the database with predefined data sets before each test.

methods.name: saveOrderGroup_shouldSaveOrderGroup
methods.description: Tests that a new OrderGroup with associated Order can be saved to the database.

methods.name: getOrderGroupsByEncounter_shouldFailGivenNullEncounter
methods.description: Verifies that passing null as encounter throws an APIException.

methods.name: getOrderGroupsByPatient_shouldFailGivenNullPatient
methods.description: Verifies that passing null as patient throws an APIException.

methods.name: getOrderGroupsByEncounter_shouldGetOrderGroupsFromAnEncounter
methods.description: Checks retrieval of OrderGroups linked to a specific Encounter.

methods.name: getOrderGroupsByPatient_shouldGetOrderGroupsGivenPatient
methods.description: Checks retrieval of OrderGroups linked to a specific Patient.

methods.name: getAllOrderGroupAttributeTypes_shouldGetAllOrderGroupAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all OrderGroupAttributeTypes and verifies their count.

methods.name: getOrderGroupAttributeTypeByUuid_shouldGetOrderGroupAttributeTypeGivenUuid
methods.description: Fetches an OrderGroupAttributeType by UUID and verifies its name.

methods.name: getOrderGroupAttributeTypeByName_shouldGetOrderGroupAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Fetches an OrderGroupAttributeType by name and verifies multiple properties.

methods.name: deleteOrderGroupAttributeType_shouldDeleteOrderGroupAttributeTypeFromDatabase
methods.description: Deletes a specific OrderGroupAttributeType and verifies it no longer exists.

methods.name: saveOrderAttributeType_shouldSaveTheProvidedOrderAttributeTypeToDatabase
methods.description: Creates and saves a new OrderAttributeType, then verifies its persistence and properties.

methods.name: getOrderAttributeTypeByName_shouldReturnOrderAttributeTypeUsingProvidedName
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderAttributeType by name and verifies its properties.

methods.name: deleteOrderAttributeType_shouldDeleteTheProvidedOrderAttributeTypeFromDatabase
methods.description: Deletes an OrderAttributeType by UUID and verifies removal.
